correctness.rationale: PASS: For each a,b>=2 the geodesic triple rule exactly yields Y=Delta_(A union B leaves) union (O_A * D_(B leaves)) union (O_B * D_(A leaves)) plus ab+a+b edges not incident to any higher face. The two join pieces meet in the full simplex on leaves; collapsing this contractible CW subcomplex gives wedge of two joins, O_A=S^(a-1) and b discrete points produce (b-1) copies of S^a, similarly (a-1) copies of S^b. All added edges have endpoints in connected Y and contribute one circle each. A leaf is not an internal geodesic vertex; own root and leaf with a third is forbidden, and the cross-shore root/leaf restrictions give the three classifications. Works integrally; when a=b higher spheres combine. Independently enumerated all graph-metric forbidden triples and legal faces for (2,2),(2,3),(3,3): face vectors (8,28,16,1),(10,45,44,19,1),(12,66,88,57,6,1), and Euler characteristics -5,-9,-18, matching Euler predictions 1 plus reduced Euler. The source checker also enumerates six small pairs; those finite tests are not an infinite proof.
